title_zh: 故宫:红墙黄瓦间的六百年
title_en: Beautiful Places in China (8/20): The Forbidden City, Six Centuries of Red Walls and Yellow Tiles
note_en: 之所以…是为了… states a purpose behind a fact already mentioned: 宫墙之所以漆成红色…，是为了体现皇帝独有的尊贵身份 "The palace walls were painted red... in order to show the emperor's unique, exalted status." Compare 之所以…是因为…, which gives a cause; 是为了 always gives a goal, like English "The reason... was to..." rather than "...was that..." Xiao Zhou uses the same frame at the end: 故宫之所以能保存到今天，是为了让后人也能看到这段历史.
